mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS manager_login_10m_stats ( id bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, window_start_at timestamp NOT NULL, window_end_at timestamp NOT NULL, username varchar(200) NOT NULL, login_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, first_login_at timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, last_login_at timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, calculated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_manager_login_10m_stats_window_user (window_start_at, username), KEY idx_manager_login_10m_stats_window (window_start_at, window_end_at), KEY idx_manager_login_10m_stats_username (username) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manager_login_10m_stats (window_start_at, window_end_at, username, login_count, first_login_at, last_login_at, calculated_at) VALUES (#{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{stat.username}, #{stat.loginCount}, #{stat.firstLoginAt}, #{stat.lastLoginAt}, #{calculatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE window_end_at = VALUES(window_end_at), login_count = VALUES(login_count), first_login_at = VALUES(first_login_at), last_login_at = VALUES(last_login_at), calculated_at = VALUES(calculated_at)
